name: infra-ops-console
description: Infra Ops Console · Centro de observabilidad (frontend React + backend Node sobre Prometheus)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev:demo"
